messages:
Maria: quick sync — we need final decisions for the marketplace launch next Wed. Specifically: LP CTA, press embargo time, and SI/hardware partner contact handoff. @Josh @Kevin @Lena @Sanjay — can we lock these today?

Josh: prefer a single strong CTA: "Request demo" for the press landing (drives enterprise leads). For product pages we can show "Start free trial". I can A/B later but press LP should be demo-first. Draft LP here: https://docs.google.com/s/marketplace-lp-draft :eyes:

Kevin: +1 on dual behavior (press -> demo, self-serve -> trial). We should show supported clouds + a short latency/cost stat above the fold. Also flag: product needs the embed for partner SI contact info (see Sarah).

Sarah: infra check — we can cutover LP Mon 05:00 PDT if all assets are in /staging/marketplace-lp by Fri 18:00. Catalog listing for cloud marketplaces needs a manifest.json and logo sizes. Example manifest snippet:```json
{
  "productName": "Redwood Inference - Marketplace Listing",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "supplier": "Redwood Inference"
}
```Please drop full manifest in the folder, we'll validate.

Lena: legal OK with embargo Tue 09:00 ET as long as PR quotes are approved by Thu EOD. Need quote drafts from marketing + partner quotes (if external SI/hw quoted). Also confirm we have no regulatory disclaimers for the partner listings. :white_check_mark:

Sanjay: SI side — shared partner contacts list here: https://sheet.company/si-contacts. I'll run a partner dry run Mon 11:00 PT (after LP cutover) to validate onboarding flow. Need staging creds for partners by Fri noon. I can file an ops ticket if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler noted: staging folder lock at Fri 18:00 UTC-7 for final content freeze. Any pushes after that require explicit release-owner approval.

Maria: action items summary — 1) Marketing: finalize press LP copy + demo CTA (Josh) by Thu EOD. 2) Legal: confirm PR quote approvals (Lena) by Thu EOD. 3) Engineering: validate manifest + staging assets (Sarah) by Fri 18:00. 4) SI: staging creds + dry run (Sanjay) by Mon 11:00 PT. 5) Ops: enforce freeze (deploy-bot). If everyone OK, I'll email partners + press contacts with embargo window today. :rocket:
